title: Copy This Facebook Ads Strategy, It'll Blow Up Your App
description:
Start building & deploying paywalls in 10 minutes flat: https://superwall.com/

Private dinners for $100k/mo app founders: https://75v4gfh4e3l.typeform.com/to/CgZbJWb6

Alex: https://twitter.com/vechalex

Timestamps:

0:00 – Intro
1:02 – Massive creator outreach: Running 1,000 Gmail accounts for scale.
1:32 – Surviving permanent bans: Dealing with Meta’s automated flags.
1:58 – The 3 core ad lessons: Captions, Green Screens, and Hooks.
4:00 – Boost App Social Journey: Scaling from a web tool to $100k MRR.
6:16 – Transition to iOS: Why mobile was the better UX fit for hashtags.
11:03 – Creative Strategy: Using VAs and Telegram to manage 300+ creators.
13:16 – Internal email systems: Sending 30,000 emails a day to influencers.
21:20 – Ad Hooks: Analyzing visual vs. copywriting triggers for high engagement.
25:03 – AI in Ads: Using agents to find outlier videos and breakout formats.
32:03 – The Exit: Negotiating a 7-figure deal with private equity.
41:12 – Screens.design: Building a library to analyze top-performing apps.

Alex managed to spend a staggering $800,000 on meta ads that just didn't work, a big chunk of the $1.5 to $1.8 million total ad spend. Out of every 85 videos, only one actually performed well. Sounds like a nightmare, right? But through all the account bans and ad flops, we learned a lot. 

The key was high volume, creating enough content to hit that one winner often enough to make a profit. Our approach was unique: we used a thousand Gmail accounts to reach out to creators, funneling them into a Telegram group for contract negotiations. This led to 300 ready-to-deploy ad creatives. 

Despite Meta's bans, we persisted, armed with data-driven insights. Three major takeaways: always use captions, utilize green screens for app demos, and go wild with hooks. These strategies led to a seven-figure exit.
